title: Self-service
description: A cross-device self-service experience, shaped by administrator settings for an IAM platform.
outcome: Turned a fuzzy, misaligned vision into something buildable within the platform's constraints, then scaled new patterns platform-wide.

title: Offering content reporting
description: A decision support tool for service offering teams that helped them remain compliant and improve offering quality.
outcome: Elevated stakeholder governance goals by grounding them in the behaviors and incentives of Offering Managers, reframing governance from compliance to quality.

title: Quarter in Review
description: A digital report for service offering leaders that provides visibility into their offering's readiness, financial performance, and consultant usage.
outcome: Turned scattered, unactionable data into a concise report that Offering Leaders could finally trust and act on — adoption spread from 1 offering to 28 in two quarters.

title: Predictive Customer Analytics
description: A cloud-based product for marketing analysts at a time when campaigns need to be personalized and time-sensitive.
outcome: Brought predictive analytics out of data scientists' hands and into marketing analysts' core workflows, taking the product from concept to limited client release.

title: Javelin Program
description: A 12-week design thinking coaching program for IBM's top 80 client account teams.
outcome: Turned an unproven pilot into a CMO-funded program, rebuilt it to scale worldwide, and adapted the framework for sellers, increasing team maturity by an average of 42% by the program's end.
